name: Vault Component Intelligence Index
purpose: Route component design questions through cross-system semantics first, then to an implementation primitive appropriate to the target stack.
selectionOrder: Resolve the canonical component family and aliases using Component Gallery.
Check whether the user task needs a different semantic component despite visual similarity.
Define states, keyboard behavior, focus, labels, validation and responsive behavior.
For React/Tailwind projects, inspect the corresponding HeroUI primitive and its tests/stories when compatible.
For other stacks, implement the behavior contract with native semantics or an accessible licensed primitive.
Apply the target business/domain visual theme after behavior is correct.
Run rendered QA; never infer correctness from source presence alone.
hardRules: Do not use a dropdown menu when a form select is required, or vice versa.
Do not use tooltips for essential interactive content.
Do not replace semantic buttons, links, labels or form controls with generic clickable containers.
Do not treat a design-system screenshot as a template to clone.
Do not assume a source is reusable without checking its license.
Do not let component-library defaults override the selected domain pack or production theme.
